subtitle: 놈리건 퀘팟에서 원딜 냥꾼만 퀘템 못 먹은 사연

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
놈리건 퀘팟 처음인데
저 기계 상자 까는 거 맞지?
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle Gnomeregan metal floor shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal riveted metal floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, eager newbie Dwarf Hunter stands back at range holding her wooden blunderbuss rifle ready in combat stance while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf cheers beside her. On the right, quick Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) darts right up to a tall boxy Gnomeregan mechanical locker box glowing with golden quest sparkles and scoops out the quest gear part first.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
나도 퀘템 완료! 먼저 챙겼어
자, 이제 막넴 잡으러 가자!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile wide Gnomeregan corridor shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal metal floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the right, cheerful Orc Warrior protection tank (1H sword sheathed at hip, sturdy steel kite shield strapped on forearm) triumphantly holds up a sparkling cogwheel quest part with her free hand beside an emptied mechanical locker box. On the left, out-of-breath newbie Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) jogs over too late with empty outstretched hands while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf trots hurriedly beside her looking bewildered.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind newbie Dwarf Hunter (green fur-trimmed hood and back-slung blunderbuss rifle in lower-right foreground, with her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf peeking beside her shoulder) looking at Night Elf Priest on the left, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background (zero text or speech bubbles). On the left, breezy Night Elf Priest (lavender half-up hair, gold crescent tiara, zero angel halo or wings, gold cross staff stowed on back) waves cheerfully while holding a glowing cyan-swirl oval hearthstone beside a tiny defeated cute 2.5-head chibi SD clockwork gnome boss lying on the metal floor.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 82 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with pale vertical shock gloom lines and zero text or speech bubbles. Newbie Dwarf Hunter (green fur-trimmed hood, thick ginger braided pigtails, blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) holds open her completely empty brown quest satchel with trembling hands, frozen in pale teary betrayal with huge glassy shocked amber eyes and a giant cold sweat drop while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf stares blankly in matching shock right beside her cheek.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
어? 냥꾼 아직 못 먹었어?
원래 그 퀘 두 번 돌고 그래~
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comedic confrontation shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal metal floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the right, shameless Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) shrugs casually with a cheeky grin waving goodbye inside a faint swirling stealth shimmer. On the left, stunned newbie Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) points frantically at her empty quest satchel with brimming tears while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf tugs desperately at her cape.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
니들은 한 번 돌고 끝내놓고
왜 나만 두 번 돌아야 돼?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view wide slapstick comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal metal floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, tearfully furious newbie Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) stomps both feet flailing her empty fists in comic rage tears while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf stomps angrily waving both paws beside her. On the far right, Orc Warrior protection tank (1H sword at hip and sturdy steel kite shield strapped on back) briskly jogs out the exit whistling innocently without looking back.
